senses.gloss: m. (v. preced.; cmp. הָדָר) apple; apple-tree; apple-shaped ball, bell &c.
units: Targ. Joel I, 12 (ed. Lag. pl.).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 25:33">Targ. Ex. XXV, 33</cite> (h. text <he>כפתר</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:4">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> trees are called by their names (of the fruits) <he>חזורא מתקרי חיזור</he> there is the apple, it (the tree) is also called apple(-tree).—Pl. <he>חִזּוּרִין</he>, <he>חִזּוּרֵי</he>, <cite ref="H00367"><he>חִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:11">Targ. Prov. XXV, 11</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:3">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> (retransl. from Aquila Prov. l. c.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 961:48">Yalk. Prov. 961</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 39:25">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXIX, 25</cite> <he>חִיזוֹרְיַין</he>.
